period: FY2025 annual windows ending between 27 December 2025 and 31 January 2026
definition: UK or UK & Ireland trade-oriented retail-style counter networks providing tools, decorating or building supplies through consistently counted customer-facing branches/stores.

candidate_peers.business_model: trade-oriented omnichannel tools and hardware retail counter network
candidate_peers.condition_qualification_reason: Three consistent annual snapshots; two intervals; cumulative movement 9.17% exceeds the unchanged 5% estate-expansion development threshold.

candidate_peers.business_model: trade-oriented omnichannel tools and building-supplies retail counter network
candidate_peers.condition_qualification_reason: Three annual snapshots exist, but cumulative movement 3.51% does not meet the unchanged 5% estate-expansion development threshold.

candidate_peers.business_model: trade-only retail-style self-select building-material branch network
candidate_peers.condition_qualification_reason: Three annual snapshots exist, but cumulative movement 1.33% does not meet the unchanged 5% estate-contraction development threshold.

candidate_peers.business_model: trade-oriented decorating and DIY convenience-store network
candidate_peers.condition_qualification_reason: Three consistent annual snapshots; two intervals; cumulative movement 9.09% exceeds the unchanged 5% estate-expansion development threshold.

candidate_peers.business_model: consumer-led big-box and compact home-improvement retail
candidate_peers.exclusion_reason: Consumer-led big-box/compact retail purpose is not the selected trade-oriented retail-counter operating format.

candidate_peers.business_model: consumer and trade home-improvement retail with design-and-installation stores
candidate_peers.exclusion_reason: The audited source set does not provide a sufficiently explicit, reconciled FY2025 ending count on the same basis; openings are not used to infer it.

candidate_peers.business_model: trade-only kitchen and joinery order-led depot network
candidate_peers.exclusion_reason: Order-led kitchen depot purpose and account relationship are not the selected retail-style tools/building-supplies counter format.

candidate_peers.business_model: consumer-led DIY, home and garden retail
candidate_peers.exclusion_reason: Geography and consumer-led format are outside the selected cohort; no comparable starting bridge is retained.

evidence.title: Kingfisher 2024/25 Annual Report and Accounts
evidence.evidence_span: Store numbers at 31 January 2025: Screwfix 952; prior official FY2023/24 disclosure: 922.

evidence.title: Kingfisher FY2022/23 final results
evidence.evidence_span: Screwfix opened 82 stores and reached 872 stores at 31 January 2023.

evidence.title: Travis Perkins 2025 full-year results
evidence.evidence_span: Store network (UK): 590 in 2025 and 587 in 2024; net three stores added.

evidence.title: Grafton Group Annual Report 2025
evidence.evidence_span: Selco branch network: 74 in 2025; prior official annual report disclosed 75 in 2024.

evidence.title: Grafton Group Annual Report 2023
evidence.evidence_span: Selco opened Peterborough and reached a 75-branch estate in 2023.

evidence.title: Grafton Group Annual Report 2025
evidence.evidence_span: Leyland SDM opened its 36th store in 2025; prior official annual report disclosed 35 stores in 2024.

evidence.title: Grafton Group Annual Report 2024 comparative estate narrative
evidence.evidence_span: Two 2024 openings were identified as the 34th and 35th stores, preserving the 33-store prior endpoint.

evidence.title: Wickes Annual Report 2025 and final-results materials
evidence.evidence_span: Five new stores are disclosed; the comparison does not infer an ending count from gross openings and an unreconciled closure reference.

methodology_caveats: The cohort is development-small and is not a population sample.
Selco and Leyland SDM share Grafton Group ownership, so those rows are not fully independent strategic decision-makers.
Screwfix includes Ireland while the other included rows are UK or Great Britain; the geographic basis is stable within the annual bridge but remains a caveat.
The feature describes estate direction only and does not establish health, productivity or success.
